items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: Connish used to play time on with him at the time. I don't know none of the other fellas

ctx.x: Do you remember who else was with Bolden when you heard him in Globe Hall? Did you know any of the other men?

Connish used to play time on with him at the time. I don't know none of the other fellas, but I don't know none of the other fellas. I may not know one of them after, but I don't know whether they didn't tell me whether they were with him because I know a good many old musicians.
Well, was he out that day when you played his tune?
